facts.text: The udev rule matches USB vendor id 0783 and product id 5725
The clone implements a variant of only the 8-channel operation mode
The README states that the sample rate is set from 300 ksamples/s to 5 ksamples/s and that the channels are placed near the middle of the 2048/4096 range
valid channel ids are 0 to 7 for the eight channels
get_time returns a 500-point time axis built as np.linspace(0., 499, 500) / samplerate, in seconds for a samplerate in samples per second
get_vscales returns the per-channel vertical scale factor; the allowed factors are 0.02, 0.125 and 1.0 (the setter comment calls them Volt/Div)
The upstream init1 sets the generator speed to 300000 rpm and switches the generator off
set_generator_on sends command 0xb7 then 0xbb with 0x01 for on and 0x00 for off; the class has no getter for the generator state
set_generator_speed asserts 1 <= speed_in_rpm <= 750_000 and sends the computed pulse length with command 0xb9
set_generator_waveform rejects a waveform longer than 62 bytes with 'Currently not supported'
set_generator_waveform accepts every waveform value at most 0b1111_1111
pause starts a keep-alive thread that pings the device every 0.01 s; cancel_pause joins it and is_paused reports whether it is set
